name: search_studies
description: Search EBI MetaboLights, the metabolomics (metabolite / small-molecule) study repository, by keyword — disease, metabolite, organism, or analytical technique (e.g. "diabetes", "glucose NMR", "Homo sapiens LC-MS"). Returns matching study accessions (e.g. MTBLS1) with name and a short description.

query.description: Free-text query, e.g. "type 2 diabetes urine NMR".

name: get_study
description: Fetch metadata for a single MetaboLights study by its accession (e.g. "MTBLS1"): title, full description, and the organisms studied (species + tissue/part). Keyless.
